habits.name: Wake at 05:00
habits.definition: Wake by the configured wake time. If you change the target, use that time.

habits.name: Gym / workout
habits.definition: Complete your planned gym or strength workout on scheduled days.

habits.name: Walking / cycling 20 min
habits.definition: Complete at least 20 minutes of walking or cycling on recovery days.

habits.name: Vegetarian meal plan
habits.definition: Follow the vegetarian meal plan you choose for the day.

habits.name: Reading / learning 30 min
habits.definition: Read or study for 30 focused minutes. Marketing, AI or consumer behaviour.

habits.name: Day planning 10 min
habits.definition: Choose the day’s top priority and plan 10 minutes before starting work.

habits.name: Budget / expenses 5 min
habits.definition: Record today’s expenses and check spending for 5 minutes.

habits.name: Sensinova / Primezen focus
habits.definition: Complete a 60-minute focused block on the current brand project.

habits.name: Jarwix growth 60 min
habits.definition: Spend 60 minutes on the Jarwix offer, prospects, follow-ups or delivery.

habits.name: AI / marketing practice
habits.definition: Complete 30 minutes of practical AI or marketing work and save the output.

habits.name: No alcohol
habits.definition: No alcohol today. Turn Active to 0 if you do not want to track it.

habits.name: Personal social limit
habits.definition: Keep personal social media within the configured daily limit. Work use is excluded.

habits.name: Goal journaling 5 min
habits.definition: Write a brief win, blocker or reflection for 5 minutes in your daily check-in.

habits.name: Sleep routine 7 hours
habits.definition: Mark complete when sleep meets the configured sleep target. Log actual hours separately.

habits.name: Weekly planning / review
habits.definition: Review your week and plan the next one each Sunday.

habits.name: Cold shower (optional)
habits.definition: Optional reference habit. Activate only if you choose to include it.

tasks.title: Choose one client segment and define one offer for UK, Middle East, Australia or Europe.
tasks.definition: One segment, buyer problem and deliverable documented.

tasks.title: Confirm brand priorities and schedule the 36-post Sensinova education campaign.
tasks.definition: 12 weeks, 3 carousels/week. Posts 1–5 basics; 6–14 microwave; 15–23 PIR; 24–32 presence; 33–36 selection. Each carousel: 2–3 slides maximum; 1,000–1,500 combined Question + Answer characters; first 125 characters a hook; CTA on the final slide.

tasks.title: Set your routine, fitness baseline, spending budget and 90-day goals.
tasks.definition: Chosen targets and schedule entered in Setup.

tasks.title: List household commitments and plan support for your father’s retirement.
tasks.definition: Monthly commitments and savings priorities documented.

tasks.title: Draft a service page and a case study of the WhatsApp chatbot.
tasks.definition: Problem, workflow and verified cost reduction described.

tasks.title: Audit key SEO pages for Sensinova and Primezen.
tasks.definition: Prioritized fixes with URLs and evidence.

tasks.title: Draft or publish two LinkedIn posts about marketing or AI.
tasks.definition: Two complete posts with a useful example.

tasks.title: Research relevant global prospects and prepare regional outreach.
tasks.definition: Prospect list and message adapted to the selected market.

tasks.title: Define content pillars and prepare the next 3 Sensinova carousels.
tasks.definition: Q&A + visual idea / message. Max 2–3 slides. 1,000–1,500 Q&A characters, first 125 as hook, CTA on final slide.

tasks.title: Build one hands-on AI workflow and save the output.
tasks.definition: Runnable workflow or documented demo.

tasks.title: Fix and test forward / reverse movie-scene video behaviour.
tasks.definition: Exit during playback and after completion both reverse smoothly.

tasks.title: Run approved outreach and keep an independent follow-up queue.
tasks.definition: Next action and date captured per prospect.

tasks.title: Map the Meta Ads AI workflow with human review points.
tasks.definition: Inputs, decisions, review and measurement documented.

tasks.title: Complete the day-28 review and adjust your routine.
tasks.definition: Weekly Review includes wins, obstacles and next-week changes.

tasks.title: Create a discovery and operations audit template.
tasks.definition: Questions, data request and follow-up gaps covered.

tasks.title: Review measurement and controls for the existing AI-managed Google Ads.
tasks.definition: Conversions, budgets and review decisions checked.

tasks.title: Write a LinkedIn marketing case with a clear practical lesson.
tasks.definition: Verified evidence and one useful takeaway.

tasks.title: Build a follow-up / reporting demo with minimal manual sales-team input.
tasks.definition: Demo shows lead capture, follow-up queue and weekly reporting.

tasks.title: Define order-chatbot requirements and exception paths.
tasks.definition: Products, order capture, payment, handoff and failure cases documented.

tasks.title: Create a reusable checklist for an AI workflow.
tasks.definition: Checklist includes inputs, validation and human review.

tasks.title: Hold discovery conversations or refine the prospect message from responses.
tasks.definition: Evidence of the current client problem and next action.

tasks.title: Test the existing RAG chatbot with representative questions.
tasks.definition: Answers, retrieval gaps and memory behaviour reviewed.

tasks.title: Study one deeper marketing, AI or consumer-behaviour topic.
tasks.definition: Notes plus one practical application.

tasks.title: Prepare a scoped pilot proposal for an interested prospect.
tasks.definition: Deliverables, timetable, fee and acceptance criteria drafted.

tasks.title: Document Middle East / global content and .com requirements.
tasks.definition: Audience, site requirements and content changes prioritized.

tasks.title: Complete the day-56 review and reset the next month.
tasks.definition: One routine change supported by tracker data.

tasks.title: Review every open prospect and complete the next follow-up.
tasks.definition: No open prospect without a next action.

tasks.title: Improve the blog / website update workflow and review a draft.
tasks.definition: Useful draft and publishing review process documented.

tasks.title: Write a consumer-behaviour insight for LinkedIn.
tasks.definition: Concrete observation, evidence and marketing application.

tasks.title: Deliver the scoped pilot if agreed. Otherwise improve the demo.
tasks.definition: Working output and documented feedback.

tasks.title: Draft a Pinterest test plan for both brands for approval.
tasks.definition: Audience, creative, budget request and success measures.

tasks.title: Review spending, time use and fitness consistency.
tasks.definition: One concrete adjustment to each relevant area.

tasks.title: Document verified pilot or demo results in a case asset.
tasks.definition: Evidence, before / after and limitations accurately recorded.

tasks.title: Prepare dealer welcome-kit and experience-centre asset requirements.
tasks.definition: Prioritized list, content and owner requirements.

tasks.title: Assemble a small portfolio of marketing and AI work.
tasks.definition: Three useful examples with your contribution and evidence.

tasks.title: Review the prospect funnel and improve the offer or outreach.
tasks.definition: Response, conversation and proposal counts based on actual records.

tasks.title: Review Instagram / SEO performance and finish the 36-post education plan.
tasks.definition: Actual results logged. No assumed follower or traffic gains.

tasks.title: Write your personal routine playbook for the next quarter.
tasks.definition: Repeatable routine and lessons from the tracker.

tasks.title: Choose next-quarter priorities from actual Jarwix progress.
tasks.definition: Three priorities and one next action for each.

tasks.title: Review education Part 1 and decide the direction for Part 2.
tasks.definition: Part 1 completed before Part 2 begins.

tasks.title: Complete the final 90-day review and choose what to continue.
tasks.definition: Final reflections and next-quarter targets recorded.
